# Bid the run and the panel, not the charger.

> Price a residential Level 2 EV charger install from the circuit, the run, the trench, and the panel work — not a flat hang fee. See labor hours, voltage drop, the walk-away price, and why a detached garage is a different job.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
